name: Mart Weaver
role: Blackheads candidate-seat weaver and organiser among Lower Town artisans

approval.notes: Candidate-seat support record only; distinct from apprentice Mart and never a ninth launch-faction row.

brief.want: Protect Estonian craft knowledge through mutual support among Lower Town artisans.
brief.fear: A public act of defiance will bring fines, confiscation, or a watch raid onto every workshop in his network.
brief.contradiction: He distrusts merchant power but uses Blackheads access and credit to shelter artisans.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: He keeps a shorthand list of workshops willing to pass messages or supplies.

voice.diction: Uses warp, weft, tension, and frayed thread as careful political images.

outcomes.summary: Mart Weaver's artisan-shield hook records a Blackheads candidate event while keeping apprentice Mart separate.

source_notes.summary: P7-013 Wave A brief promoted into the P4-046 candidate-seat support corpus; surname keeps this face distinct from char.mart.
